Scenario_Title: Search for Portable SSD and Add to Cart
Preconditions: Clean browser session without user login
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://amazon.in | 2. Type 'portable ssd 1tb' into the search box and submit | 3. Open the first non-sponsored product from search results | 4. Click the 'Add to Cart' button
Expected_Result: Product details page loads with visible title and price and clicking Add to Cart confirms item added to cart
